description: Codex: Orks (11e) MOB MENTALITY (Green Tide, 1 CP, your Command phase) through the real battle_shock_step_start window (design §3). Fixture ork11e_orks_active: P1 Orks active. Setup privileges: P1's detachment is switched to Green Tide; Boyz B gets 2 extra Boyz (12 Boyz + the attached Warboss = 13 models, 19.03); 6 Beast Snagga Boyz are removed so they must make a battle-shock roll; both players' CP are set to 4. Re-entering the Command phase (the real phase entry: Core CP +1, battle-shock queue) opens the window at the START of the battle-shock step: the StratagemDialog offers MOB MENTALITY on Boyz B with an enabled Use button. A real click on Use opens the unit pick (only units that must test, within 12" and visible); a real click on the Beast Snagga Boyz spends 1 CP and sets their auto-pass. The battle-shock roll call is then driven through the real panel button + Roll: the Beast Snaggas' roll is AUTO-PASSED — MOB MENTALITY (no dice).

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Green Tide"
StratagemManager.load_faction_stratagems_for_player(1)
var boyz = GameState.state["units"]["U_BOYZ_B"]
var m6 = boyz["models"][5]
var m10 = boyz["models"][9]
var a = m6.duplicate(true)
a["id"] = "m11"
a["position"] = {"x": float(m6["position"]["x"]) - 60.0, "y": float(m6["position"]["y"])}
var b = m10.duplicate(true)
b["id"] = "m12"
b["position"] = {"x": float(m10["position"]["x"]) + 60.0, "y": float(m10["position"]["y"])}
boyz["models"].append(a)
boyz["models"].append(b)
var bsb = GameState.state["units"]["U_BEAST_SNAGGA_BOYZ_A"]
for i in range(6):
	bsb["models"][i]["alive"] = false
	bsb["models"][i]["current_wounds"] = 0
GameState.state["players"]["1"]["cp"] = 4
GameState.state["players"]["2"]["cp"] = 4
SceneRefs.main()._recreate_unit_visuals()
return StratagemManager.find_faction_stratagem_by_name(1, "MOB MENTALITY")

steps.comment: a real player answers the other start-of-phase prompts (secondary-mission review, ...) first — they are exclusive windows
the battle-shock step waits for the decision
only the unit that must test (within 12", visible) is listed
dismiss the unrelated start-of-phase prompt again (A Tempting Target objective pick) so the roll call is unobstructed
